The '''Morton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Majoor sector/Legends|Majoor sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morton (planet)|Morton]].
